# SortableJS (vendored, unchanged)

- **What**: drag-and-drop for lists, by the SortableJS contributors. Used as the base for UI-09 (ordering lists by dragging, also by touch).
- **Source**: npm package `sortablejs` 1.15.7, https://registry.npmjs.org/sortablejs/-/sortablejs-1.15.7.tgz, file `Sortable.min.js`.
- **Licence**: MIT, see `LICENSE` beside this file.
- **SHA-256** of `Sortable.min.js`: `bf4241bc73fef7f11c59a283a69fe8051cdd31c6d8ff5a2b9ba219e7831fcf76`
- **Changes**: none. phpChess's own code that uses it lives in `public/assets/js/drag-and-drop/`.
- **Network calls**: none. A search of the unminified `Sortable.js` of the same package finds no `XMLHttpRequest`, `fetch`, `importScripts`, `WebSocket` or `sendBeacon`.
